Title: Natural product score
Description: Scores how closely a molecule resembles a natural product, using the Bayesian measure introduced by Ertl and colleagues at Novartis. Atom-centred fragment frequencies were compared between the CRC Dictionary of Natural Products and 290,000 synthetic compounds from an in-house collection, and their log-odds are summed, so a positive score means natural-product-like chemistry and a negative one synthetic character. Ersilia serves the implementation contributed to RDKit, which also reports how much of the molecule the reference fragment set covers.
Interpretation: Natural product likeness scored from -5 to 5, with higher meaning more natural-product-like, plus a fragment-coverage confidence.
